bundle.shortDescription: InkOS with local agent-CLI model providers
bundle.longDescription: Quire runs InkOS Studio against the agent CLIs installed on your machine (Claude Code, Codex, Devin, Antigravity), exposing every model they offer through one local OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
